corey.pm: Quick question from the all-hands: when you said 'staged hiring waves', what defines wave priority?

ceo.elena: Priority is impact to customer SLOs and unblock for Dedicated capacity. Wave 1 targets runtime stability and infra.

leo.eng: To be concrete: wave 1 = 10 seats (runtime + infra ops), wave 2 = 7 seats (model-serving + infra tools), rest depends on throughput.

sophie.peopleops: We'll publish reqs as "PRIORITY" or "STANDARD" in Greenhouse. Internal transfers allowed; managers must present a 45-day backfill plan or approved reprioritization.

maya.recruiter: We'll run internal mobility parallel to external recruiting. If you're applying internally, DM me and we'll flag your profile so you skip initial screen.

corey.pm: Any change to interview loops for senior infra roles?
sophie.peopleops: Slight tweak: add a short incident reasoning exercise and a systems-design 1:1. Full rubrics in #devex by Friday.

ceo.elena: Org charts will be updated next Wednesday. We'll also post a one-pager per team with new responsibilities and leads.

hiring-bot: "Hiring queue updated: 17 reqs created; 10 tagged PRIORITY. See https://intra.redwood/hiring"

leo.eng: If managers need overlap time for handoffs, approve up to 3 weeks overlap; flag needs to People Ops ASAP.

corey.pm: Thanks  will loop my PMs and flag risk areas before end of week.

sophie.peopleops: Thanks everyone, follow-up doc + FAQ will land in #all-hands later today.
